metadata.content_lifecycle: lifestyle post, luxury-casual self-care moment, high-engagement aesthetic content

subject.description: Young blonde woman reclining in a luxury hotel bed, wearing pink under-eye patches and pink over-ear headphones, snacking on potato chips while using a rose gold laptop. Styled self-care / 'soft life' aesthetic with visible luxury markers (jewelry, marble, branded snacks).

face.shape: oval with slightly rounded cheeks, soft chin
face.expression: relaxed, slightly parted lips mid-chew, eyes directed off-camera

eyes.details: long lash extensions or heavily coated mascara, bright limbal rings, under-eye area covered by pink hydrogel patches

face.nose: straight bridge, narrow, slightly upturned tip, small rounded nasal lobes
face.lips: medium-full, naturally pink, soft cupid's bow, slightly parted holding a chip
face.jawline: soft but defined, rounded at the chin
face.cheekbones: high and softly rounded, lightly flushed
face.eyebrows: dark brown (high contrast with blonde hair), thick, sharply defined with brow pomade, arched with straight body and subtle taper

skin.tone: fair with warm peach undertone, light tan
skin.texture: smooth with faint pore visibility on nose and forehead, subtle natural sheen
skin.finish: dewy satin, slight highlight on cheekbones and cupid's bow

makeup.style: polished 'clean girl' glam with editorial brow focus
makeup.details: defined dark brows, warm bronzer on cheeks, soft blush, nude glossy lip, full lashes, no visible eyeshadow due to under-eye patches

hair.color: platinum icy blonde with cooler roots, very light contrast
hair.style: loose, center-parted, falling over right shoulder and spilling behind the headphones
hair.texture: straight with soft loose waves at the ends

body.build: slim with enhanced bust, small waist, toned arms
body.posture: semi-reclined, propped up against multiple pillows, torso slightly rotated to her right as she looks off-frame
body.anatomy_notes: visible cleavage framed by cropped silver tank; midriff partially visible between crop top and duvet; left hand raised to mouth holding a chip, right hand resting on laptop keyboard; natural collarbone definition; slight softness at upper arm
body.skin_detail: even-toned with subtle natural shadowing at collarbones and sternum, faint freckle/mole near décolletage, no visible blemishes but pore texture preserved on face

top.fit: tight, cropped above navel, thin straps
top.details: slightly shimmering satin or metallic jersey fabric, scoop neckline revealing cleavage

jewelry.earrings: not clearly visible, obscured by hair and headphones
jewelry.necklace: diamond/crystal tennis necklace, fine, close to collarbone
jewelry.rings: multiple gold and diamond rings on right hand (including a wide band with stones on index and a solitaire on ring finger); gold band visible on left hand
jewelry.wrist: gold Cartier-style Love bracelet on left wrist; gold watch with diamond bezel (Rolex Datejust aesthetic) on right wrist; additional thin diamond tennis bracelet on right wrist

props: pink over-ear Beats headphones (Beats Solo / Studio style)
rose gold Apple MacBook (Air, visible Apple logo)
large blue Lay's Original potato chip bag tucked between arm and pillow
single potato chip held to mouth
KitKat chocolate bar in red wrapper on nightstand
black cordless hotel telephone on nightstand

pose_and_action.pose_type: seated-reclined in bed, three-quarter torso to camera
pose_and_action.action_description: sitting up against pillows in a hotel bed, laptop open on lap, right hand resting on keyboard, left hand lifted to mouth placing a potato chip between lips, chip bag propped against her left side, gaze directed off-camera to the right (likely looking at a screen or mirror)
pose_and_action.head_tilt: slight tilt to her left, chin neutral
pose_and_action.torso_orientation: rotated approximately 15-20 degrees to her right, facing slightly away from camera
pose_and_action.hand_placement: left hand raised near mouth with chip pinched between thumb and index; right hand flat on laptop keyboard
pose_and_action.gaze: off-camera to her right, soft and unfocused, not engaging the lens

environment.location_context: high-end hotel (likely 5-star European or Middle Eastern property based on marble and brass finishes)
background_elements: white Calacatta marble wall with dramatic black veining behind headboard
vertical brushed brass / gold wall sconces flanking the bed
floor-to-ceiling cream drapery partially visible on far left
fluffy white duvet covering lower body
environment.atmosphere: cozy, indulgent, intimate luxury; 'rich girl night in'
environment.time_of_day: evening / night (artificial warm indoor lighting, no daylight visible)

camera.specific_hardware_guess: iPhone 14 Pro / 15 Pro main wide camera, shot by second person
camera.shot_type: medium shot, waist-up with laptop in foreground
camera.framing: subject centered-right, leaving nightstand and marble wall as environmental context on left
camera.camera_angle: slight low-to-eye level, camera held roughly at bed height pointing slightly upward
camera.perspective_notes: photographer positioned at foot of bed, slight wide-lens distortion giving foreground duvet and laptop prominence; natural depth from bed to back wall
camera.depth_of_field: moderately deep — subject and background both readable, mild natural falloff on far nightstand items
composition_rules: rule of thirds (subject's face on upper-right intersection)
leading lines via marble veining and vertical brass sconces

lighting.primary_source: warm tungsten interior lighting from wall sconces and ambient room lamps
lighting.direction: mixed — key light from camera-left / front casting soft shadow on right side of face; ambient bounce from white bedding filling shadows from below
lighting.shadows: soft and low-contrast, gentle shadow under chin and on right side of face, mild shadow behind subject on headboard
lighting.highlights: controlled highlights on forehead, cheekbones, cupid's bow, and silver top; specular highlights on jewelry and MacBook lid

aesthetic_and_style.overall_archetype: Luxury Lifestyle / 'Rich Girl Self-Care' / Soft Life content

color_palette.color_harmony: warm neutral base with cool pastel pink accents and strategic primary-color product pops

aesthetic_and_style.contrast: medium, soft-contrast overall with bright highlights on subject
visual_references: Alix Earle / Tana Mongeau influencer bedroom content
'getting ready / chill night in' Instagram carousel staple

post_processing.filter_aesthetic: warm lifestyle preset, slight peach-orange lift in midtones, lifted blacks
post_processing.skin_retouching: light — skin looks smoothed on larger areas but pore texture is partially preserved around nose and forehead, hint of gentle frequency separation
post_processing.body_editing: not clearly evident; proportions read natural
post_processing.color_grading: warm highlights, soft creamy midtones, slightly crushed shadows, boosted saturation on branded product colors (red, blue, pink)
digital_artifacts: mild luminance noise in shadow areas
slight chromatic highlight on brass sconces
subtle sharpening halo around hair edges

style_and_realism.rendering_notes: preserve smartphone-shot authenticity, mild preset-style grading, natural bedding texture, sharp product labels, honest face and body proportion

mood_and_expression.expression: caught-in-the-moment snacking, lips softly parted, unfocused off-camera gaze suggesting distraction by a screen

quality_and_technical.sharpness: sharp on subject's face, jewelry, and product labels; softer toward edges
quality_and_technical.noise: low to moderate, slightly visible in darker shadow pockets

constraints: preserve left-hand-to-mouth gesture with pinched chip
preserve right-hand flat on laptop keyboard

depth_control.purpose: Depth, volume, and camera-to-body spatial lock
constraints: preserve foreground dominance of duvet and laptop

forbidden_concepts: camera angles that change volume from reference
